title: Inverse image of etale sheaves of modules over a constant ring is exact
statement: Let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $R$ a commutative ring, $R_U$ and $R_V$ the constant sheaves of rings with value $R$ on the small etale sites $U_{\Et}$, $V_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and $\Mod(T_{\Et},R)=\Mod(R_T)$ the abelian category of sheaves of $R_T$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $u^{-1}:\Ab(V_{\Et})\to\Ab(U_{\Et})$ be the inverse image of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Then: (1) the inverse image of the sheaf of rings $R_V$ is canonically isomorphic to $R_U$; (2) for a sheaf $G$ of $R_V$-modules, $u^{-1}G$ carries a unique structure of sheaf of $u^{-1}R_V$-modules, hence of $R_U$-modules through (1), such that $u^{-1}$ of the action map is the action map; this defines a functor $u^{-1}:\Mod(V_{\Et},R)\to\Mod(U_{\Et},R)$ compatible with $u^{-1}$ on abelian sheaves under the forgetful functors, equal to the module pullback $u^*G=u^{-1}G\otimes_{u^{-1}R_V}R_U$; (3) this functor is additive and exact (it preserves finite limits and finite colimits), and it is left adjoint to the direct image $u_*$ on sheaves of modules.

source.place: Lemma 04JC (lemma-flat-pullback-exact): f^{-1} is exact on abelian sheaves and f^* is exact for a flat morphism of ringed topoi; here u is flat as a morphism of ringed sites because u^{-1}R_V -> R_U is an isomorphism (constant sheaves: sites.tex Example 0H7J, Mor(E, F) = Map(E, Gamma(F))); used in sites-cohomology.tex Section 0735 (section-base-change-map) for flat pullback on D^+
